messages.author: 09607d3641d0afd1
messages.subject: Re: Analysis Run Warning
parts:
Alex and Andy:

Have a look at the question/answer to this question on this list from 7 August 2015:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/distance-sampling/pajxia1n8Mo

You need to have administrator privilege to both install and run Distance on your Windows machines.  I presume you are both using "company" rather than "personal" machines.  As an experiment, install Distance onto a "personal" machine on which you have full privileges; you should be able to run analyses without the error appearing.  You may then want to have a conversation with your IT folks about re-configuring your "company" computer.

By the way, Distance 7 is currently in beta release, if you wish to use that (http://distancesampling.org/Distance/distance70Beta3download.html).
